methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 6 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in AI & Software. Range: $8.3B - $39.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Scale AI operates in the AI & Software sector as a private company currently valued at $29.0B. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of six same-sector, similar-valuation-tier companies spanning Series A through Series F stages, alongside one public comparable (Palantir) and eight private comps including Figure AI, Reflection AI, Applied Intuition, Skild AI, and Crusoe Energy.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach given data availability. The six-company peer cohort yields a median valuation of $14.5B, with a range spanning $8.3B (floor) to $39.0B (ceiling). This dispersion reflects stage and capital-raise heterogeneity across the AI infrastructure and application stack. The peer-median result of $14.5B serves as the anchor point for the triangulated range.

The analysis supports a valuation band of $12.3B to $16.7B around a median of $14.5B. The current $29.0B valuation sits materially above peer-median benchmarks, reflecting either differentiated market position, revenue or growth metrics not captured in this comp set, or premium pricing relative to similar-stage, same-sector peers. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and growth trajectory relative to peers, capital efficiency of the $14.8B raised to date, and potential sector repricing as AI infrastructure markets mature.
